verdict: Paid ads have not launched; five milestones are overdue and blocking revenue.
narrative: No paid activity ran on Meta or Google during the last 28 days — no spend, no paid leads, and no paid clicks. All 73 actions recorded this period came from your organic Google Business Profile. Five launch milestones — including the stack test, LSA verification, site go-live, ads launch, and Meta retargeting — were each due by August 1 and remain incomplete, which is why paid campaigns have not started. On top of that, your Google Business Profile went completely dark September 1–6 after averaging roughly 3–4 actions per day through late August; we are investigating whether this is a listing issue and working to restore normal activity immediately. Resolving the overdue milestones is the priority so paid campaigns can activate and your pipeline can start receiving traffic.
